goal: Show academic fit, program fit, and future direction in a formal and credible way.

structure.instruction: State the academic interest and the problem area the applicant wants to work on.
Explain relevant study, performance, projects, and research preparation.
Show practical experience that supports the chosen course.
Explain the course content, specialization, and relevance.
Mention specific academic features, faculty, labs, subjects, or facilities.
Describe realistic short-term and long-term goals.

structure_logic.present: Why the applicant needs this course now.
structure_logic.future: What the applicant will do after completion.

red_flags: Copying mission statements from the website
Weak connection between previous study and chosen course
Career plans that are unrealistic or immigration-heavy
Repeating the same idea in multiple paragraphs
Mentioning every job instead of only relevant ones
banned_phrases: I have always wanted this since childhood
I will do anything to get in
I want to stay in Australia permanently
this course is my ticket to Australia
preferred_language: My prior study provided a foundation in...
This course will strengthen my capability to...
The university's curriculum aligns with my research interests in...

paragraph_focus.work_or_research_experience: Only experience that supports the course.

quality_checklist: The SOP answers why, what, where, and after
The language is formal and academic
Every claim is believable and supported
The university and course are named specifically
The flow is clean and non-repetitive
